# Function to check if three words form a word chain
def check_word_chain(A, B, C):
    # Check if the last character of A matches the first character of B
    # and if the last character of B matches the first character of C
    return A[-1] == B[0] and B[-1] == C[0]

# Main function to read input and print the result
def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    A, B, C = data[0], data[1], data[2]
    
    # Call the check_word_chain function and print the result
    if check_word_chain(A, B, C):
        print("YES")
    else:
        print("NO")

# Execute the main function
if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
